column1: # A CINEMA SEASON's banner over stage relays — a name under which venues bill MORE THAN ONE house's productions — one
# banner a line, `banner<TAB>where<TAB>why`. Read by `services.movies.StageHouse` (`seasonBanners`) for the identity model:
# a relay billed under one of these may take another house's record of the season its screenings fall in; a relay whose
# banner names any other house never does (`services.identity.StageRelays.anotherProduction`, the owner 2026-11-13).
# Matched as a run of the banner's words, a season's numbers, "the", "and" and a house's split initials ("RB&O") aside.
# Found on the local prod mirror's five corpora (2026-11-13): PL "Royal Ballet and Opera Sezon Kinowy", DE "RBO Kino
# Saison" and UK "Opéra de Paris Ballet Season" bill only their own house's relays; the Royal Ballet & Opera's UK cinema

column3: the Royal Ballet & Opera's UK cinema season carries the Met's 2026/27 productions under the house's name: Pocklington's "Royal Ballet & Opera: Macbeth", Acton's "ROYAL BALLET & OPERA LIVE: MACBETH" and Northallerton's "RBO: MACBETH (MET)" screen the Met's Macbeth
RBO Cinema Season 2026-27: Macbeth and "… La Fanciulla Del West" are the Met's productions
